data: You cover the ground in a thin, healing mist that surrounds a {shape}, centered on you. For 3 turns, no grounded creatures inside the mist can suffer from new status conditions. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability. In addition, grounded creatures in the terrain are resistant to dragon-type damage, or if they were vulnerable to dragon-type damage, they take regular damage instead.
Excites the audience a lot if used first.
Raises the crowd meter by 2 if successfully performed first in correct contest, raises the crowd meter by 1 if successfully performed first in complementary contest.
